name: TV DIABLO Windows
note: v2150: The contested rule existed twice and only one copy was ever fixed. proposal_from_pages learned to ask resolve_contested whether the NEWEST look says found and to leave such a name out of contested; merge_proposals recomputed the same field at its tail with the original membership-only rule. Every sweep after the first goes through the merge, so the unfixed copy was the one writing his screen: his live proposal said 64 contested where the resolver says 34, thirty names all sets and every one of them a name whose newest reading FOUND it. The merge also never wrote contestedResolved, contestedExpired or notFoundDatable, so the console card that reports exactly this population had no field to render from and could not appear at all. One derivation now, two callers.
